items.title: Fix flaky DER signature length assertion in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a flaky assertion in the DER signature length check that was causing intermittent CI failures. The assertion has been modified to validate the DER structure instead of relying on a fixed length, ensuring that valid shorter signatures are no longer misreported. Extensive testing has confirmed the fix, with 30 consecutive successful runs post-implementation.

items.title: Enhance Audience Segmentation with Multi-Select Feature in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update transforms the audience segmentation card from single-select to multi-select, allowing users to send emails to multiple segments simultaneously. Key changes include the introduction of an array for audience segments and improved compatibility with existing data. The update also ensures that at least one segment is retained to prevent unintended mass mailings.

items.title: Enhance Audience Rules with Multi-Segment Support in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces support for multi-segment audience rules, allowing users to target multiple segments in a single campaign. The implementation utilizes an 'OR' logic to include any selected segment, ensuring backward compatibility with existing single-segment rules. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate the functionality and ensure robustness.

items.title: Fix dead session tab reservation issue in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where expired sessions were preventing users from accessing their tabs. By ensuring that expired session records are removed during the tab claiming process, we eliminate the risk of stale sessions reserving tabs indefinitely. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate the changes, ensuring a smoother user experience.

items.title: Enhance Email Marketing Features in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses several key issues in the email marketing functionality. It fixes the recipient list not refreshing after changing segments, adds a loading indicator for segment changes, and improves the layout by positioning the recipient adjustment next to the segment list. Additionally, a preview feature for segments has been introduced, allowing users to view group members without changing the selected segment.

items.title: Exciting New MCP Servers for Captcha Services in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces new MCP servers for hcaptcha, image2text, recaptcha, and turnstile, enhancing the capabilities of our captcha-related services. Each service follows the established webextrator pattern, ensuring consistency and ease of use. Additionally, all endpoints now support asynchronous handling, allowing for more efficient task management.

items.title: Enhance hcaptcha CLI with task command in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new `task` command to the hcaptcha CLI, enabling users to poll for results of asynchronous captcha tasks. Key changes include the addition of `get_task()` and `print_task_result()` functions, along with the necessary command registration and testing fixtures. This enhancement improves user experience by providing real-time task status updates directly from the CLI.

items.title: Enhance Masking for Sensitive Headers in Frontend Web 🔒
items.summary: This update improves the display of masked sensitive headers in the webhook settings. The masking now uses fixed-length dots to prevent revealing the actual length of the token, and the real value is only shown when explicitly requested. Additionally, the submission process has been adjusted to ensure that the masked value is correctly handled without overwriting the actual token.

items.title: Fix(console): 连接器/技能页样式对齐 Studio 控制台 in Nexior 🐛
Normalize Translations in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update standardizes the translations block across 12 OpenAPI files following the recent sync. Key changes include reordering translation keys, adding missing line breaks, and converting hardcoded descriptions to translation references. The files have been verified for stability, ensuring no content changes while improving structure.

items.title: Introducing Local Search Tools: fs.glob and fs.grep in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update adds two powerful read-only search tools, fs.glob and fs.grep, to the Nexior local tools. Users can now efficiently search for files by name or content without the need for external commands, significantly improving the retrieval process. The implementation includes robust safety checks and extensive testing to ensure reliability and security.

items.title: Enhance Local Tools with Precise Editing and Pagination in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces two significant features to the local tools: `fs.edit_file` for precise string replacement and `fs.read_file` with pagination capabilities. The `fs.edit_file` function allows for unique string replacements while preserving file permissions, and the `fs.read_file` function now supports reading files in segments, preventing silent truncation for large files. These enhancements improve efficiency and safety when handling file operations.

items.title: Align Upload Button in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update fixes the alignment issue of the 'Upload Invoice PDF' button in the invoice details modal, which was previously 5px higher than other controls. By setting 'show-file-list' to false, the button now aligns perfectly with its peers, enhancing the overall UI consistency. The change also simplifies the display of selected file names.

items.title: Docs sync confirms no CLI code changes needed in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update finalizes the Docs sync request by auditing various services against recent OpenAPI updates. The review confirmed that the monorepo is already aligned, with no source changes required. Notably, the `fish` CLI was found to be compliant with the updated format constraints, eliminating the need for any patches.

items.title: Decommissioning Two Services Due to Missing Secrets in Platform Service 🚫
items.summary: This update addresses the ongoing issues with two services, `kickart` and `phoenix`, which have been unable to start due to missing secrets. The replicas for both deployments have been set to zero, with comments added in the YAML files detailing the reasons for decommissioning and the conditions for restoration. This change will help reduce resource consumption while maintaining the deployment configurations for future recovery.

items.title: Fix MCP Dependencies to Prevent CrashLoopBackOff in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the dependency constraints for 25 projects to limit the `mcp` version to less than 2.0.0, addressing a critical issue that caused services to crash due to the removal of the `fastmcp` module. The change ensures that future builds will not encounter the same problem, stabilizing affected services like `mcp-aichat` and `mcp-seedance`. Additionally, the `uv.lock` file for `suno` has been updated to reflect the new dependency specification.

items.title: Fix order display for settled amounts in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where order amounts were displayed using live exchange rates instead of the settled amounts. A new function, `getOrderPriceString()`, has been introduced to ensure that the displayed price reflects the frozen settlement amount, preventing discrepancies caused by currency fluctuations. This change enhances the accuracy of order displays across various sections, including order lists and details.

items.title: Enhance desktop tool functionality and security in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses five critical issues in the desktop local tools, enhancing security and functionality. Key changes include improved file system consent scopes, a functional shell PATH for commands, and the introduction of session grants for all tools. Additionally, macOS folder TCC strings have been added, and the write_file function has been made crash-safe.

items.title: Enhance Local Execution for Scheduled Tasks in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new execution mode for scheduled tasks, allowing them to run locally on the user's desktop instead of solely in the cloud. Key changes include the addition of an `execution` parameter and the implementation of a local task initiation process via the Electron main process. This enhancement aims to improve the usability of local tools while maintaining cloud-based task management.

items.title: Enhance Outbox Resilience Against Socket Failures in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of outbox events during socket failures by ensuring that truncation warnings are retained for future connections. The `_send_envelope` method now returns a boolean indicating whether the message was successfully sent, allowing the system to manage unacknowledged sessions more effectively. Two new test cases have been added to validate these changes, confirming that the warnings persist even during connection issues.

items.title: Fix replay issues in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses critical replay issues where old content was erroneously replayed during user sessions. Key changes include enhancing the replay guard mechanism and ensuring that only new messages are processed, preventing the leakage of previous responses. Additionally, several tests have been added to validate these fixes, ensuring the robustness of the system.

items.title: Enhance Midjourney Task Filters for Better Usability in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the Midjourney task commands with the latest Docs schema, introducing new options for task retrieval and batch processing. Users can now utilize `--trace-id` for individual tasks and `--trace-ids` for batch lookups, enhancing the command's flexibility while maintaining existing functionalities. The changes ensure that the Midjourney CLI remains aligned with current standards without affecting other services.

items.title: Align Task Metadata Documentation with Latest Updates in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the task metadata documentation with recent changes, including the introduction of `started_at` and `elapsed` fields, replacing the outdated `duration`. Additionally, it removes unsupported Fish `opus` guidance to ensure consistency with the upstream API. Regression tests have been expanded to verify that the new fields are correctly formatted and retained in task payloads.

items.title: Enhance Task Timing Documentation in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the documentation for task timing fields, specifically `started_at`, `finished_at`, and `elapsed`, which were previously missing from the documentation. Key changes include adding detailed descriptions across 23 task documentation files and updating 28 OpenAPI schemas to include these properties. This ensures that users have clear guidance on task timing, enhancing overall usability and reducing confusion.

items.title: Update task duration field to elapsed in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the documentation across six task files to replace the outdated `duration` field with the correct `elapsed` terminology. Key changes include updates to examples and field descriptions, ensuring users receive accurate information and preventing undefined values. Additionally, the OpenAPI example for Midjourney tasks has been updated accordingly.

items.title: Enhance Task Timing Reporting in Platform Service ⏱️
items.summary: This update ensures that failed tasks now report their elapsed time, addressing inconsistencies in timing data across various workers. Key changes include modifications to the error handling in the task processing flow and adjustments to how elapsed time is calculated and stored. Additionally, regression tests have been added to verify the accuracy of these changes.

items.title: Fix(deployment): 微信未运行时给出「重启微信」按钮，不再只留一句干着急的提示 in Frontend Web 🐛
Enhance WeChat Recovery Mechanism in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where devices were stuck in a 'not_running' state after the WeChat process exited unexpectedly. By implementing a relaunch mechanism within the existing coordinator logic, the system can now automatically restart WeChat, ensuring a seamless user experience without manual intervention. The changes have been validated through extensive testing and are expected to improve the reliability of WeChat bots significantly.

items.title: Align TTS CLI Options with Latest Docs in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update refines the TTS CLI options for the `fish` service to align with the current API schema. The unsupported `--opus-bitrate` option has been removed, and the available formats are now restricted to `mp3`, `wav`, and `pcm`. Additionally, the command help output has been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring a smoother user experience.

items.title: Align Fish Audio Formats with OpenAPI Spec in M C Ps 🎶
items.summary: This update removes the unsupported 'opus' format from the FishAudioFormat type definition and eliminates the 'opus_bitrate' parameter from the fish_generate_audio function. These changes ensure consistency with the upstream OpenAPI specification, enhancing the clarity and reliability of the audio generation tools. The modifications streamline the codebase by removing unnecessary elements.

items.title: Align Audio Format Documentation with Actual Support in Backend 🎶
items.summary: This update modifies the OpenAPI documentation for the `/fish/tts` endpoint to accurately reflect the supported audio formats. The `format` enum now only includes `mp3` and `pcm`, and the `opus_bitrate` field has been removed as it is not applicable. Additionally, example audio URLs have been updated to point to real CDN links, enhancing clarity for developers.

items.title: Fix task timeout issues in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical bug in the Discordace service where tasks were incorrectly reported as 'timed out' due to upstream errors not being properly recognized. Key changes include enhancing the error handling in the SDK and ensuring unsupported formats are rejected immediately, preventing unnecessary polling. The improvements lead to clearer error messages for users and more efficient task management.

items.title: Fix resource upload order and type declarations in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses two critical issues in the resource handling of the aichat2 module. The upload-resource block is now positioned before the skill body to prevent truncation, ensuring that essential references are preserved. Additionally, type declarations for receipt fields have been added to enhance type safety and prevent silent data loss during processing.

items.title: OpenAI CLI Sync Check Completed in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update confirms that the OpenAI CLI is fully aligned with the latest OpenAPI documentation. An audit of the `openai/` package revealed no discrepancies, with all endpoints and parameters matching the current specifications. As a result, no changes were necessary, and the issue has been resolved through verification.

items.title: Validated OpenAI Docs Alignment in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update confirms that the current OpenAI MCP implementation is fully aligned with the latest OpenAPI contract, requiring no changes to the source code. The validation process checked various components, including model enums and endpoint paths, ensuring everything is in sync. As a result, the sync issue has been resolved without any file modifications.

items.title: Update documentation for image edits API in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects inaccuracies in the documentation for the OpenAI Images Edits API. Key changes include clarifying the maximum number of reference images allowed and correcting the response format descriptions. These adjustments ensure that users have accurate information for utilizing the API effectively.

items.title: Increase Multipart Image Limit to 16 in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update raises the multipart image upload limit from 11 to 17, accommodating up to 16 reference images as per OpenAI's specifications. It also improves error handling by ensuring that any upload exceeding the limit returns a 400 status instead of a 500 error, enhancing the overall user experience. The changes affect multiple workers, aligning them with the new limits and error handling protocols.

items.title: Fix email status mismatch in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a contradiction in the email marketing feature where the status title incorrectly indicated that global sending was enabled while it was actually paused. The title now accurately reflects the state of the sending feature, ensuring users receive clear and consistent information. Additionally, internationalization files have been updated to align with these changes.

items.title: Refactor hardcoded origin lists for improved security in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update removes two hardcoded origin lists from the frontend, aligning it with the backend's dynamic `return_url` whitelist. The changes enhance security by ensuring that the frontend no longer maintains its own host lists, relying instead on a backend-signed token for origin validation. This prevents potential issues with new clients where the frontend might not recognize valid origins, ensuring a smoother user experience.

items.title: Strengthen Opener Origin Validation in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update implements a critical security fix for validating the `opener_origin` directly within the backend. It ensures that only trusted origins are signed, preventing potential exploitation from malicious URLs. The changes include modifications to the signing logic and enhanced test coverage to verify the new behavior.

items.title: CLI Sync Verification Complete in Clis 🚀
items.summary: The CLI has been thoroughly audited against the latest OpenAPI spec, confirming that all models, aspect ratios, resolutions, and request body fields are in sync. Key changes from recent documentation commits were reviewed, and no code modifications were necessary. This ensures that the CLI remains aligned with the current API specifications.

items.title: Update frames validation to match OpenAPI spec in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update enforces the maximum frames parameter to 289 in the `seedance_generate_video` and `seedance_generate_video_from_image` functions, aligning with the latest OpenAPI specification. The Pydantic validation now includes constraints to ensure the frame count is between 29 and 289, enhancing runtime validation and preventing invalid inputs.

items.title: Enhance Email Recipient Management in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature allowing users to manually add recipients outside of the selected segment by entering their email or user ID. The system now provides feedback for various scenarios, ensuring accurate additions and preventing duplicates. Additionally, any previously excluded users will be automatically removed from the exclusion list upon being added back.

items.title: Clean Up Dead Code and i18n Keys in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update removes obsolete code and 1,176 dead internationalization keys from the email marketing module. Key changes include the deletion of unused CSS, a non-existent button method, and outdated backend actions. The cleanup enhances code maintainability and optimizes performance across multiple languages.

items.title: Add Retry Failed Recipients Feature in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature on the campaign details page that allows users to resend emails to recipients who previously failed to receive them. The option to 'Retry Failed' will only appear when there are eligible recipients, and it creates a draft for review before sending. Additionally, several internationalization files have been updated to support this new functionality.

items.title: Expanded Reference Image Limit to 16 in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update raises the reference image limit for the OpenAI image editing feature from 5 to 16, aligning with the official OpenAI specifications. Key changes include updating the limit in the UI component and adjusting internationalization files to reflect the new limit across 18 locales. The change enhances user experience by allowing more flexibility in image uploads without backend dependency.

items.title: Enhance Popup Security with Backend Origin Signing in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces backend support for signing the popup opener origin, enhancing security by eliminating hardcoded host lists in the frontend. The backend now validates and signs the origin, allowing for synchronous verification without additional network calls. Key changes include the addition of a unique salt for the opener origin and improved testing for origin validation.

items.title: Enhance Email Campaigns with Retry Feature in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new endpoint to clone failed email recipients into a fresh draft for retrying campaigns. The implementation ensures compliance by retaining audit records and only targeting recoverable failures. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate the functionality, with all existing tests passing successfully.

items.title: Fix attachment handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses two critical issues with attachment management in the conversation flow. It ensures that attachments sent by users are preserved during the confirmation process and modifies the resource queue to be session-scoped, allowing for proper retrieval of file identifiers. Extensive testing has confirmed the effectiveness of these changes, with all new tests passing successfully.

items.title: Reveal Sensitive Headers with New Functionality in Frontend Web 🔍
items.summary: This update introduces a feature that allows users to view sensitive request headers by clicking a 'Reveal' button, fetching real values from the backend. Additionally, it eliminates redundant local copies of sensitive headers and updates placeholder examples to reflect actual variable names. The documentation has also been revised to clarify the new functionality.

items.title: Enhance Webhook Header Visibility in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new endpoint to retrieve sensitive webhook headers on demand while maintaining security through masking. The backend now sends a list of sensitive headers to the frontend, eliminating the need for manual maintenance. Additionally, the header name matching is now case insensitive, improving usability and consistency.

items.title: Dynamic Whitelist Update for Return URLs in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the return URL whitelist to dynamically query allowed hosts from the Site table, reducing hardcoded entries to just localhost. It introduces a TTL cache for host lookups to enhance performance and ensures that new white-label domains can be onboarded without code changes. Additionally, a behavior change is noted where `dify.acedata.cloud` is now denied access unless added to the Site table.

items.title: Strengthened Domain Throttling and Blacklist Updates in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update reduces the per-domain registration limit to 5 accounts per hour and adds 8 domains to the blacklist to combat abuse. A new CronJob has been implemented for automated risk scanning, enhancing security measures against fraudulent registrations. The changes aim to significantly reduce the potential for abuse while maintaining service for legitimate users.

items.title: Enhance Browser Tool Card Testing in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces comprehensive stream regression tests for the browser tool card, addressing two previously fixed bugs. The tests ensure that the real reducer and component interactions are validated, covering scenarios like successful completions and error handling. All tests have passed successfully, confirming the robustness of the fixes.

items.title: Enhance MCP Tool Image Handling in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update improves how MCP tool images are processed by ensuring that images returned by tools are surfaced correctly to the model instead of being buried in JSON. The first liftable image block is now extracted and displayed, while non-liftable images are noted, enhancing user experience by providing clear feedback on image visibility. Testing confirms that the changes are robust and do not introduce regressions.

items.title: Fix misleading email delivery status in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the email delivery status was inaccurately reported as 100% due to hardcoded values in the SMTP health check. Key changes include replacing the misleading 'delivery event callback' with a more accurate global sending switch and updating the delivery rate explanation to clarify that 'delivered' only indicates server acceptance. These adjustments enhance transparency for operations regarding email delivery outcomes.

items.title: Enhance Email Delivery Insights in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the email delivery funnel by displaying all recipient states, including previously hidden statuses like 'Skipped' and 'FailedPermanent'. Additionally, it provides detailed reasons for undelivered emails and translates error codes for better clarity. An estimated time of arrival for email delivery is now visible, enhancing operational efficiency.

items.title: Enhance Email Delivery Reports with Skip Reasons in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature to the email delivery report API, aggregating skip reasons based on the last error codes. Previously, operators had to manually filter through multiple recipient states to understand delivery issues. Now, they can easily see why recipients were skipped, improving operational efficiency and clarity.

items.title: Fix browser tool card freezing and missing results in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses two main issues with the browser tool in chat: the card was stuck in a loading state and the results were not displayed. The execution sequence logic has been corrected to allow proper state transitions, and the UI for the browser tool has been updated to match other tools, enabling visibility of input/output and execution duration. Comprehensive tests have been added to ensure functionality.

items.title: Enhance Email Creation with Per-Person Selection in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the ability to select recipients individually when creating a new email, eliminating the need to save a draft first. The change automatically creates a draft upon entering the second step of email creation, allowing immediate selection without disrupting the user experience. Key adjustments were made to the campaign composer and audience recipient table components to support this functionality.

items.title: Fix attachment receipt handling for uploads in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where uploaded attachments were missing critical metadata, causing failures in processing by the model. The changes ensure that all necessary fields, including file_id, sha256, mime, and size, are preserved during the upload process. Additionally, the classification of uploaded files has been improved to correctly identify file types based on mime type rather than just file extensions.

items.title: Streamline Skill Management in Nexior Console 🎉
items.summary: This update integrates skill management directly into the Nexior console, allowing users to manage skills without leaving the platform. The UI has been migrated to the `/console/skills` route, while the underlying data remains managed by AuthBackend. Key changes include the addition of several new components for skill browsing and management, along with comprehensive internationalization support across 18 languages.

items.title: Enhance Webhook Variables and Secure Sensitive Headers in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new format for webhook variable tables, displaying both placeholders and their descriptions side by side for easier understanding. Additionally, sensitive request headers like 'Authorization' are now masked as password fields to enhance security. Other improvements include updated placeholder texts and better internationalization support.

items.title: Revamp Webhook Content Management in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the webhook system by allowing administrators to customize message templates, removing hardcoded content. Key changes include the introduction of a single source for event variables and improved error handling for header management during webhook creation. Additionally, tests have been expanded to ensure robustness and consistency across the system.

items.title: Fix email confirmation message for accurate recipient count in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where the email confirmation dialog inaccurately reported the number of recipients. The logic has been adjusted to ensure the correct count of active paying users is displayed, enhancing clarity for users. Additionally, the confirmation message now specifies the segment of recipients, improving user understanding of the email's reach.

items.title: Fix email recipient count reporting issue in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical bug where the UI inaccurately reported the number of recipients for email campaigns. A new `rule_total` has been introduced to ensure that the total number of recipients is correctly calculated, independent of search filters. This change prevents misleading confirmations and enhances the accuracy of email dispatches.

items.title: Streamlined Connector Management in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update integrates connector management directly into the Studio console, enhancing user experience by eliminating the need to navigate to an external site. The UI has been migrated while maintaining the existing data layer as read-only, ensuring consistency and security. A feature flag allows for easy rollback if needed, and the authorization process has been improved with a popup mechanism for better usability.

items.title: Enhance OAuth Flow with Popup Return Page in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new popup return page for managing OAuth connections within the Studio console. The addition of `PopupReturn.vue` allows for seamless authorization without refreshing the calling page, improving user experience. Key changes include enhanced postMessage handling and origin validation to ensure secure communication.

items.title: Enhance return_url security with dynamic allowlist in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a dynamic allowlist for the `return_url` parameter to prevent open redirect vulnerabilities. It replaces the static whitelist with a database-driven approach, allowing legitimate custom domains while blocking unauthorized ones. The changes enhance security for connections and ensure compliance with white-label requirements.
